offers.title: Manufacturing Cost Accountant (H/F)
offers.description:
Position Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented Manufacturing Cost Accountant with 1–2 years of experience to support cost accounting and financial analysis within a manufacturing environment. The role focuses heavily on variance analysis (material, labor, and overhead) to provide actionable insights that improve plant performance, cost control, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities
1. Variance Analysis (Core Focus)
• Prepare and analyze monthly cost variances between actual and standard costs (material, labor, and overhead).
• Investigate root causes of variances (e.g., scrap, inefficiencies, price fluctuations) and provide clear explanations to management. 
• Partner with operations, production, and engineering teams to identify corrective actions and cost improvements. 
• Monitor and report production, purchase price, and usage variances to highlight trends and risks. 

2. Cost Accounting & Product Costing
• Assist in maintaining standard costing systems, including updating Bills of Materials (BOM) and routing assumptions. 
• Support product costing and margin analysis for existing and new products. 
• Track and analyze manufacturing costs (raw materials, labor, overhead). 
• Validate cost of goods sold (COGS) and ensure accurate inventory valuation. 

3. Month-End Close & Reporting
• Participate in month-end close activities, including journal entries, inventory adjustments, and WIP reconciliation. 
• Prepare cost reports, variance reports, and gross margin analysis for plant leadership. 
• Reconcile inventory accounts and support financial reporting accuracy. 

4. Inventory & Operational Support
• Assist with physical inventory counts, cycle counts, and inventory audits. 
• Monitor inventory movements and accuracy of production transactions. 
• Analyze production efficiency, including labor utilization and scrap rates. 

5. Budgeting & Continuous Improvement
• Support budgeting and forecasting for manufacturing costs. 
• Identify cost reduction opportunities and recommend process improvements. 
• Help improve costing processes, controls, and reporting accuracy. 

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field. 
• 1–2 years of experience in cost accounting, manufacturing accounting, or financial analysis. 
• Exposure to standard costing and variance analysis required.
• Experience with ERP systems (Business Central, Navision, SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.) preferred. 
• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, data analysis). 

Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to interpret cost variances and translate into operational actions
• Knowledge of manufacturing processes and cost drivers
• Effective cross-functional communication with operations and finance teams
• High attention to detail and accuracy

Preferred Attributes
• Internship or early-career experience in a plant or manufacturing environment
• Familiarity with inventory accounting and WIP tracking
• Exposure to lean manufacturing or continuous improvement initiatives

Success Metrics for the Role
• Accuracy and timeliness of variance reporting
• Quality of root-cause analysis and recommendations
• Improvements in cost visibility and operational decision support
• Reduction in unexplained or recurring cost variances

Join Schneider Electric’s Heavy Industries segment team and play an active role in supporting the energy transition. As part of the global Strategy & Marketing organization, you will contribute to the development of key industrial sectors including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Mining, Metals & Minerals, while supporting emerging sustainable industries such as Green Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Biofuels, Plastics Recycling, Green Mining, Green Glass, Green Cement and Green Steel.
 
You will join an international and multicultural team with a global responsibility, supporting a community of nearly 1,000 professionals worldwide. Based in Hoofddorp, Netherlands, you will report directly to the Heavy Industries Segment Director and collaborate with experts, strategic account managers, sales leaders and product management teams across Schneider Electric.
Your Mission
As a Market Analyst, you will provide market and competitive intelligence to support business strategy, account development and growth initiatives across Schneider Electric’s Heavy Industries segment.
 
Your role will combine market research, strategic analysis, stakeholder engagement and business intelligence to help identify opportunities and guide decision-making in rapidly evolving industrial markets.
Your Responsibilities
Support segment strategy and strategic account management through market, customer, competitor and ecosystem intelligence.
Identify and analyze market trends across heavy industries and emerging decarbonization sectors.
Quantify CAPEX and OPEX opportunities and assess market attractiveness.
Conduct market sizing studies, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Available Market (SAM) and growth potential analyses.
Deliver country, regional, segment or account-focused market assessments.
Manage access to market intelligence databases and provide quantified insights for internal strategic processes, including the Annual Market Review (AMR).
Build and maintain visibility on key customer projects and strategic opportunities across priority markets.
Support strategic initiatives through targeted analyses, including:
Country and account strategic plans;
Deep dives into new industrial sectors;
Investigations of innovative technologies and start-up ecosystems.
Evaluate opportunities and market entry scenarios for new applications and sub-segments.
Organize regular exchanges with Schneider Electric’s strategic intelligence community.
Support the animation of the Heavy Industries community through technical sessions, offer presentations and knowledge-sharing activities.
Own and manage the segment newsletter.
Collaborate closely with technical experts, strategic account managers, regional sales directors and product line managers worldwide.
This position offers strong development opportunities and may evolve towards leading a strategic initiative or driving business development activities within one of the sectors you investigate.

Want to kick-start your career in an international and dynamic environment?
Join SII through a V.I.E program and enjoy a unique human and technological experience!

Role Summary

The Middle Developer is an experienced and autonomous software engineer capable of delivering medium‑to‑large technical tasks with minimal supervision. This role requires solid knowledge of software development principles, hands‑on expertise with modern technologies, and the ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional teams.
 Middle Developers play a critical role in designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing applications, while contributing to technical decision‑making, code quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Software Design & Implementation
• Independently design and implement scalable, maintainable, and high‑quality software solutions.
• Translate functional requirements into technical specifications and well‑structured code components.
• Lead medium‑complexity features from concept to deployment, ensuring best practices are consistently applied.
• Refactor legacy components to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability.

2. Code Quality & Reviews
• Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards.
• Mentor junior developers by guiding them through coding patterns, best practices, and architectural decisions.
• Identify technical risks, propose mitigation strategies, and ensure early detection of potential issues.

3. Testing & Quality Assurance
• Develop comprehensive unit, integration, and API tests to ensure robustness and maintainability.
• Collaborate with QA engineers to analyze defects, reproduce issues, and drive solutions efficiently.
• Contribute to improving the testing framework and automation coverage across services.

4. Maintenance & Troubleshooting
• Diagnose performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and runtime issues across distributed systems.
• Investigate and resolve production incidents, ensuring root‑cause analysis and permanent fixes.
• Optimize application performance and reduce operational costs where applicable.

5. Collaboration & Cross‑Team Alignment
• Work closely with product owners, UX designers, architects, and engineering leads to align on technical direction and business priorities.
• Contribute to sprint ceremonies: estimation, planning, retrospectives, and demos.
• Communicate progress and blockers effectively to maintain transparency within the team.

6. Continuous Improvement & Innovation
• Stay informed about new tools, frameworks, and industry trends relevant to the tech stack.
• Propose improvements to the development workflow, architecture, or tooling (CI/CD, testing, monitoring, etc.).
• Actively participate in architecture discussions, sharing insights and best practices.

offers.title: Data & BI Engineer – Python, Power BI & Web Development (H/F)
offers.description:
À propos du poste :

Au sein de l'équipe Data Services & Insights, vous participez à la conception et au développement de solutions data destinées aux différents métiers du Groupe.
Le poste est principalement orienté Business Intelligence et Data Engineering, avec une forte composante Power BI, Python et développement web.
Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valorisation de la donnée : récupération des données via APIs et bases de données, transformation et modélisation, développement de datasets et rapports Power BI, ainsi que développement d'interfaces web permettant d'exploiter les données et les services développés par l'équipe.
Le poste offre ainsi une exposition à plusieurs domaines : Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, API development et Web development.

Missions principales :

1. Python, APIs & Data Engineering :
• Développer des traitements de données en Python. 
• Consommer et intégrer des APIs REST et différentes sources de données. 
• Développer des scripts et services permettant d'automatiser la récupération, la transformation et la mise à disposition des données. 
• Transformer et préparer les données pour leur exploitation dans Power BI ou dans des applications web. 
• Participer au développement et à la maintenance des pipelines de données. 
• Mettre en œuvre des contrôles de qualité et de cohérence des données. 
• Optimiser les traitements existants en fonction des volumes et des performances.

offers.description:
The Mission
As part of MFL’s Production team, you’ll support production operations across Western Europe (mainly the Netherlands, with Germany, Belgium and France) from raw material sourcing to manufacturing, filling and delivery. Our process combines proprietary SSF, maturation and downstream processing. This hands-on, cross-functional role covers process engineering, production, quality, supply chain, logistics and equipment, working closely with CMOs, warehouses and suppliers.

What You’ll Do

* Execute production plans with manufacturing partners.
* Monitor process performance, yields and key parameters.
* Support process optimization, troubleshooting, scale-up and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate equipment selection, installation and validation.
* Transfer processes from R&D to production.
* Manage production planning, inventory and work orders in Odoo.
* Perform quality controls, ensure compliance, manage deviations and maintain traceability.
* Plan raw material purchases and ensure supply availability.
* Coordinate suppliers, CMOs, warehouses and logistics through to finished products.

What You Bring

* Engineering degree in Process, Chemical, Food, Biotechnology, Industrial Engineering or related field.
* Hands-on mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork in multicultural environments.
* Comfortable working with suppliers, CMOs and production sites.
* Interest in food, fermentation and sustainable production.
* Experience with ERP systems (Odoo is a plus) and standard office software.
* Willingness to learn new digital tools (e.g. Monday.com).
* Flexibility to support production outside standard office hours when required.
* Interest in production equipment and manufacturing facilities is a plus.
* Fluent French (VIE requirement) and English; Dutch is an advantage.

offers.title: Ingénieur Electrique H/F (H/F)
offers.description:
Et si les produits que vous concevez aujourd'hui alimentaient demain des avions dans les aéroports de plus de 60 pays ?
Chez TLD Powervamp, entreprise en pleine croissance et pionnière de l'alimentation électrique au sol zéro émission dans l'industrie aéronautique, vous piloterez l'intégralité du cycle de vie d'un produit en tant que Product Line Engineer : de la première idée à la production à grande échelle, et de notre site de Bedford jusqu'aux pistes du monde entier.
Rejoignez notre équipe Engineering et façonnez la nouvelle génération d'équipements de soutien au sol (GSE) électriques et éco-responsables.

Vos responsabilités :

Rattaché(e) au Senior Expert Engineer, vous concevez, développez et maintenez les systèmes électriques, électroniques et de puissance qui équipent la gamme de GSE de Powervamp. Vous intervenez sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement, de la conception de l'architecture jusqu'au déploiement en production en passant par les essais pratiques, en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs hardware et une équipe d'ingénierie pluridisciplinaire. Votre mission : garantir une intégration du matériel et des systèmes de contrôle-commande précise, de haute qualité et rigoureusement documentée, répondant aux exigences élevées de performance et de sécurité de l'environnement d'assistance au sol aéroportuaire.
Concrètement, vous serez amené(e) à :

- Conception des équipements : élaborer et mettre à jour les schémas électriques, plans de câblage et implantations de composants des GSE à l'aide d'outils de CAO (ex. SEE Electrical).
- Intégration système : intégrer les composants électriques aux ensembles mécaniques et concevoir des faisceaux électriques et assemblages de câbles robustes.
- Essais et validation : rédiger les procédures d'essai, réaliser les tests, analyser les données et diagnostiquer les défauts afin de garantir la fiabilité opérationnelle.
- Conformité et sécurité : veiller à la conformité de l'ensemble des conceptions électriques aux normes et réglementations de sécurité applicables.
- Documentation : rédiger les rapports techniques, nomenclatures (BOM), manuels d'utilisation et plans de maintenance.
- Collaboration transverse : travailler main dans la main avec les ingénieurs mécaniques, les développeurs logiciels, les équipes de production et les fournisseurs pour mener les projets à bien.
- Saisie de schémas : concevoir les schémas de circuits électroniques et optimiser le routage des cartes en termes de performance et de fabricabilité.
- Intégration : raccorder capteurs, moteurs et variateurs aux automates programmables (API/PLC) et concevoir les interfaces homme-machine (IHM) destinées aux opérateurs.
- Compétences techniques : maîtrise de la saisie de schémas, des systèmes de contrôle-commande par automate et des systèmes basse et haute tension.
offers.profile:
Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou niveau BAC+5 en génie électrique ou électronique, et vous justifiez d'au moins 1 ans d'expérience en ingénierie électrique dans un environnement industriel, idéalement dans le secteur des équipements lourds, des systèmes industriels ou de l'assistance au sol aéroportuaire.
Vous maîtrisez la distribution de puissance, les systèmes basse tension, les automates programmables et la commande de moteurs, et vous avez déjà travaillé avec le protocole de communication CAN (Controller Area Network). Doté(e) d'un vrai sens pratique, vous êtes à l'aise pour accompagner la fabrication des prototypes, relever les informations sur le terrain et les retranscrire en CAO.
Méthodique et rigoureux(se), vous abordez chaque problème avec minutie : vous savez lire des relevés de signaux, isoler les causes racines et documenter clairement vos conclusions. Votre regard va au-delà du banc d'essai : vous gardez en tête le comportement de vos systèmes dans les conditions réelles d'exploitation aéroportuaire et ce que cela implique en termes de fiabilité, de sécurité et de support après-vente.

Bon(ne) communicant(e) et doté(e) d'un réel esprit d'équipe, vous contribuez volontiers aux revues techniques transverses et travaillez naturellement aux côtés des ingénieurs hardware et mécaniques. Vous savez passer du développement de nouveaux produits à la maintenance de gammes existantes, ou d'un sujet de schématique à un support faisceaux, sans perdre de vue vos engagements de livraison. Enfin, proactif(ve) et orienté(e) résultats, vous faites preuve d'initiative et cultivez un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue.

Postulez dès maintenant et participez à l'essor de la nouvelle génération d'équipements de soutien au sol. #WeAreTLD ✈

offers.description:
UCB cherchant à développer son pôle biopharmaceutique en Belgique a besoin de ressources humaines aux compétences spécifiques afin de gérer depuis ce pôle la production de ses produits actifs dans le traitement des maladies auto-immunes. UCB France cherche dès lors à renforcer les compétences locales par des ressources en VIE, dans un but de maîtrise et d'optimisation de la compétitivité de ses productions, distribuées à l'échelle mondiale.

Vous êtes passionné(e) par la transformation des données scientifiques complexes en informations exploitables ? Vous souhaitez jouer un rôle clé dans la digitalisation du développement pharmaceutique ? Rejoignez UCB et contribuez, grâce à la science et à la technologie, à améliorer la vie des patients.

Le poste

Au sein de l’équipe CMC Development Digital Sciences, vous soutiendrez le développement de procédés de fabrication robustes et performants en valorisant pleinement les données générées en laboratoire. Vous serez l’interlocuteur privilégié des scientifiques pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de visualisation et d’analyse des données.

Vos principales missions
🔹 Compréhension des besoins scientifiques

- Collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour cerner leurs besoins en visualisation de données, analyses et génération automatisée de rapports.

- Veiller à ce que ces besoins contribuent à une meilleure compréhension des produits et procédés, et à l’accélération des projets.

🔹 Conception et mise en œuvre de solutions

- Définir des solutions adaptées en exploitant les plateformes digitales déjà en place chez UCB.

- Promouvoir des approches harmonisées et standardisées.

- Développer des prototypes pour valider certaines hypothèses ou faciliter la communication avec les utilisateurs.

🔹 Validation, déploiement et accompagnement

- Coordonner les activités de validation pour garantir la fiabilité des solutions mises en place.

- Assurer leur déploiement et former les utilisateurs afin d’intégrer pleinement ces outils dans leur quotidien.

Le(la) volontaire sera chargé(e) de :
- Collaborer avec les scientifiques pour définir leurs besoins en termes d'analyse et de visualisation de données
- Déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées pour répondre à ces besoins
- Mettre en oeuvre ces solutions, depuis leur prototypage jusqu'à leur validation et industrialisation
- Coordonner les activités de partenaires externes lorsque nécessaire
- Accompagner le changement pour assurer une utilisation optimale des solutions en place
offers.profile:
Votre profil
🔹 Compétences personnelles et attitude:

- Une véritable passion pour la visualisation et l’analyse de données, à la fois sur le plan théorique et pratique.
- Une forte capacité à comprendre les besoins des scientifiques et à fédérer les parties prenantes autour d’objectifs communs.
- D’excellentes aptitudes en communication, y compris la capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes.
- Une grande autonomie dans l’organisation de votre travail ainsi qu’une capacité à coordonner les activités de partenaires internes ou externes.
- Une exigence élevée en matière de qualité : vous ne transigez jamais sur la rigueur et la fiabilité des solutions livrées.
- Et surtout : une curiosité naturelle, l’envie de tester, d’innover et d’apprendre de vos expériences.

- Maîtrise pratique d’au moins un langage de programmation : Python et/ou R.
- Bonnes connaissances des bases de données et du langage SQL.
- Capacité à choisir et concevoir des visualisations de données pertinentes selon le type d’analyse.
- Connaissances théoriques en analyse multivariée (ex. : analyse en composantes principales).
- Une expérience avec des outils de visualisation comme Power BI, Spotfire ou Qlik Sense est un atout.
- Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

- Diplôme de niveau Master (ou équivalent) dans un domaine pertinent.
- Une première expérience d’au moins 24 mois, en contexte académique ou industriel, dans une fonction similaire ou connexe.

offers.title: STABILITY RESEARCH CHEMIST (M/F) (H/F)
offers.description:
Context of the mission:
During the development phase of a drug product, the stability study plays a crucial role as it makes it possible to define the shelf life of the product and ensure the quality and safety for our patient.

The analytical chemistry and stability laboratory of renal care is looking for a research chemist to complete the current team located in Castlebar, Ireland. The new team member will support the stability study for Vantive peritoneal Dialysis (PD) portfolio for a period of 12-24 months

Details of the mission: 
The goal of the stability study is to discover and observe the behaviour of the product overtime in particular the degradation of the active ingredients present in the solution. The objective is to provide evidence that the quality of the drug remains within the defined or required standards throughout its shelf life and under the influence of a variety of environmental factors such as temperature, humidity and light based on the country’s legislations.

Our GMP laboratory is able to perform all the physical, chemical and physiochemical testing. The team is among many other responsibilities and competencies, performing the dosage of active ingredients and impurities, identification of particulate contamination, motoring of degradation products. The choice of the correct parameters to be analysed as well as suitable analytical methods are the basis for meaningful and convincing data.

Role and responsibilities:
Working within the QA Chemistry team to ensure compliance to Chemistry processes and procedures and is responsible for, but not limited to.
• Co-ordination of Stability Study Chapter VI program
• Weighing & Sampling of Stability studies
• Generation of reports for Stability Studies
• Co-ordination of samples to the relevant labs
• Compiling data and reviewing data for each stability study
• Generation and approval of Annual Product Code review
• Generating Temperature and Humidity graphs from Eurotherm software on a monthly Basis.
• Monthly Maintenance Activities
• Liase with and support on going projects
• Liase with and co-ordinate with external service suppliers

Benefits to join your team:
In addition to the above the chemist role will involve: 
• Analysis of samples from various phases of the manufacturing process
• Interpret data and meet strict guidelines on documentation when recording data
• Report analytical results
• Experience in a GMP environment and 6S laboratories in a pharmaceutical industry
• Develop techniques for the analysis of drug products and chemicals
• Work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
• Liaise with chemists and production personnel to ensure compliance and efficiencies are met.
• Be aware of, and keep up to date with, health and safety issues
• Validate methods and equipment.
• Support other activities within the Quality department as assigned by the Quality Manager.
• Support the generation and approval of Quality Reviews and Annual Product Quality Reviews
• Identify continuous improvement and collaboration opportunities, promoting development and implementation of quality data and reports for improvement and optimization of business processes / results.
• Support the batch release process
• Support the QA dept in the preparation for and during inspections.
• Support new product introductions from a QA perspective.

Sous la supervision d’un Program Manager :
• Contribuer au pilotage de projets de robotisation des mouvements et du transport de produits, composants et matériels au sein des zones de production et de conditionnement : systèmes robotisés, cobots, convoyeurs, AGV/AMR, solutions de manutention automatisée et interfaces avec les équipements existants.

Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement stimulant où vos idées sont valorisées ? Rejoignez Coengi et devenez acteur du changement !

offers.title: EMULATION ENGINEER  (H/F)
offers.description:
Introduction to ELSYS DESIGN :

Embedded systems: your passion, our expertise. 

ELSYS Design is an engineering company specialized in the design of embedded electronic systems. 

We have four main areas of expertise: microelectronics (FPGA, ASIC, SoC), hardware, embedded software, and systems. 

We primarily operate from our offices, serving clients from various sectors (energy, space, semiconductor, automotive, railway, defense, aerospace, telecommunications, IoT, medical, security, multimedia, etc.). 

Joining ELSYS Design means: 

- Sharing a passion for technology with: an engineering culture, an innovation hub, an in-house design office ensuring technical excellence. 

- Benefiting from an HR culture centered around you: exciting projects for rapid skill development, knowledge sharing within expertise communities, room for mistakes, and supportive management. 

- Being part of a company where work-life balance is valued: a friendly atmosphere, flexible hours/remote work possibilities, and numerous recreational and sports activities. 

See you soon! 

ELSYS Design key figures: 

- 700+ engineers 

- €58M in revenue 

- 14 locations in France, Portugal, Serbia, and the United States 

Key responsibilities :

- Develop/modify/enhance functional/stress tests to find silicon bugs on emulator 

- Interface with Central Emulation team responsible for helping to develop, debug and establish CPU/GPU Emulation environment. 

- Provide debug leadership, input to test plans and hands on execution 

- Work with extended teams to debug environment, drive cross team testing (Firmware, Software, Diags/tools, Validation, Apps) 

- Triage failures with design, verification, firmware, software, and emulation teams 

- Research and enable new tools and infrastructure to support emulation activities 

- Run and collect data for analysis on high-end emulators and simulation models 

- Develop scripts/tools to parse data from emulation runs
offers.profile:
Qualification Requirements: 

- BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Electronics, Automation or related software disciplines 

- Experience working on emulation platforms such as Veloce, Zebu, or Palladium (compilation, debug, performance, and throughput tuning) 

- Debugging experience is a must particularly in HW/SW co-debug environments 

- Ability to trace code across multiple domains and root cause using waveforms and other tracing tools 

- Understanding of Verilog, VHDL design 

- Understanding of System Verilog, UVM verification environments is a plus 

- Working knowledge of Linux/Unix environment and shell scripting 

- Programming skills, C, C++, Python, Tcl, Ruby 

- Experience with Emulation of full-SoC design with embedded processors 

- Familiarity with industry standard high-speed protocols such as PCIe and CXL is a plus 

- Fluent English is a must

offers.description:
Prêt(e) à façonner l’avenir de la fabrication de précision ?
Vous êtes passionné(e) par les technologies industrielles, curieux(se) de comprendre comment les produits sont fabriqués et motivé(e) par le défi de développer de nouveaux marchés ?
Rejoignez Fives et participez au développement de notre présence sur l’un des marchés industriels les plus dynamiques d’Europe !
Fives est un groupe international d’ingénierie industrielle qui conçoit et fournit des solutions de pointe aux industriels du monde entier.
Au sein de notre BU Grinding | Ultra Precision, nous développons des technologies et solutions de rectification de haute précision destinées à de grands acteurs industriels des secteurs de l’automobile, de l’aéronautique, de l’énergie, du roulement et d’autres industries exigeantes.
Grâce à des marques reconnues à l’international et à une expertise d’ingénierie présente en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie, nous accélérons aujourd’hui notre développement commercial en Allemagne.
Nous recherchons un talent entreprenant, proactif et curieux sur le plan technique pour contribuer à cette ambition.
Votre mission : Découvrir. Créer des liens. Développer.
Basé(e) à Stuttgart et en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes internationales commerciales et techniques, vous jouerez un rôle actif dans l’expansion de notre présence sur le marché allemand.
Vos principales responsabilités
• Explorer le marché : identifier de nouveaux clients industriels, des projets d’investissement, des applications émergentes et des opportunités commerciales à travers toute l’Allemagne.
• Ouvrir des portes : approcher de manière proactive des prospects, développer des relations avec les décideurs industriels et organiser des visites sur site.
• Créer des opportunités : comprendre les enjeux de production des clients et identifier comment les technologies et services de rectification de Fives peuvent leur apporter de la valeur.
• Développer l’intelligence marché : suivre la concurrence, les tendances du secteur, les évolutions technologiques et les grands investissements industriels.
• Activer notre réseau : collaborer avec les différentes entités internationales de Fives afin de mettre les clients en relation avec les experts et solutions les plus pertinents.
• Représenter Fives : participer à des salons professionnels, événements sectoriels et activités de networking.
• Piloter la performance commerciale : construire et maintenir un pipeline structuré de prospects qualifiés, de contacts clients et de nouvelles opportunités d’affaires.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Une véritable mission de développement commercial, et non un simple rôle de support
Chez Fives, vous aurez l’opportunité de :
• Prendre la responsabilité d’un projet stratégique de développement de marché.
• Travailler directement avec des responsables commerciaux internationaux et des experts techniques.
• Évoluer au contact de technologies de fabrication avancées et de clients industriels de premier plan.
• Développer vos compétences commerciales, techniques et stratégiques.
• Construire un solide réseau professionnel international.
• Contribuer de manière tangible à la croissance d’un groupe industriel mondial.
Vous bénéficierez du soutien d’équipes expérimentées tout en disposant d’une réelle autonomie pour prendre des initiatives et obtenir des résultats.

offers.title: Electrical Project engineer (H/F)
offers.description:
agap2 is a European engineering consultancy active across various industrial sectors such as large infrastructure works, process industries (life science, food & beverage, chemistry), energy, and transport. Present in 13 European countries and established in Belgium since 2013, we collaborate with partners across the country.

As an Electrical Project Engineer, you manage and support the full lifecycle of electrical engineering projects — from design and planning to execution and commissioning. You ensure that electrical systems meet technical requirements, safety standards, deadlines, and budget expectations.

Main Responsibilities:
• Develop and review electrical designs, schematics, and technical specifications.
• Participate in feasibility studies and define project scopes and requirements.
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (mechanical, automation, construction, utilities…).
• Prepare tender documents, evaluate bids, and support subcontractor selection.
• Ensure correct implementation of electrical installations during construction and commissioning.
• Conduct technical analyses, risk assessments, and ensure compliance with relevant standards (AREI/RGIE, IEC…).
• Monitor project progress, budgets, and deliverables.
• Provide technical support during FAT/SAT, testing, troubleshooting, and validation.
• Act as a technical point of contact for clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
offers.profile:
Your profile:

- Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electromechanics, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
- First experience in electrical design, project engineering, or industrial installations.
- Good knowledge of electrical systems: low voltage, power distribution, instrumentation, control systems.
- Be adaptable, autonomous, and proactive to meet the diverse challenges of our missions.
- Ensure clear communication and effective collaboration with all stakeholders.
- Professional efficiency in English & French, Dutch is a plus

Why joining us? 
- Close support with dual follow-up: one from HR and the other from your Business Manager.

offers.title: INGENIEUR HSE (H/F)
offers.description:
Are you passionate about making a tangible impact on safety and environmental performance at an international industrial site?
Do you want to take the lead in driving HSE initiatives daily as the local focal point, and sustainably reinforce the safety culture within a world leader in aerospace?
Join Safran Aerosystems and contribute to the challenge of HSE excellence at our Van Nuys site!

Safran Aerosystems (SAO) designs high-tech solutions that optimize aircraft performance and flight safety. As the world leader in emergency evacuation systems and crew oxygen systems, Safran Aerosystems is also a major player in fuel and fluid systems.

The Customer Support & Services (CSS) division is the after-sales network of Safran Aerosystems (SAO), a leading provider of onboard equipment and systems for airplanes and helicopters.

As a VIE HSE & Facilities Engineer at the Van Nuys site, you will be responsible for the implementation and continuous improvement of the site's HSE management system, while also overseeing Facilities activities. Based on site and working with a high level of autonomy, you will be the main local point of contact for HSE and Facilities matters, reporting to a manager based in Atlanta and working in close coordination with the person responsible for global HSE coordination.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Driving continuous improvement of the HSE management system through annual risk assessments and risk-reduction initiatives.
• Identifying needs, defining priorities, and managing HSE action plans covering safety, health, environment, ergonomics, and workplace well-being.
• Leading HSE improvement projects and supporting site projects by integrating HSE requirements from the design phase.
• Ensuring the implementation of Safran HSE standards and improving the site's level of compliance.
• Implementing existing HSE procedures and creating or adapting local procedures when needed.
• Managing incidents and accidents, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, reporting, and escalation.
• Coordinating internal and external HSE audits and following up on associated action plans.
• Tracking HSE performance indicators and communicating results to relevant stakeholders.
• Strengthening the site's safety culture through communication, awareness initiatives, HSE events, and training.
• Monitoring water and energy consumption, carbon footprint, and related environmental improvement actions.
• Overseeing Facilities activities, including building, premises, infrastructure, and gas piping network maintenance.
• Coordinating service providers, supporting site security activities, and sharing best practices with other Safran sites.
offers.profile:
We are looking for someone who is autonomous, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of HSE and Facilities topics in an industrial environment.

You should have:
• Strong ability to work independently, organize priorities, and drive actions to completion.
• Strong communication, persuasion, and influencing skills, with the ability to justify recommendations and engage different stakeholders.
• Ability to work effectively with both operational teams and management.
• Good knowledge of international HSE, environmental, and ergonomics processes and standards.
• Knowledge of HSE management systems in a manufacturing environment.
• Strong knowledge and practical understanding of risk assessment methodologies and risk management processes.
• Good command of root cause analysis and problem-solving tools, such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa diagrams, and fault tree analysis.
• Knowledge of OSHA requirements and/or California HSE regulations is a plus.
• An educational background in HSE or a closely related HSE field is required.
• Good level of English, both written and spoken.
• Spanish is a plus.
• Previous experience in the aerospace industry is a plus.

Get on board with this adventure and join us!

Contribute to the excellence of Safran AEROSYSTEMS in a dynamic and multicultural work environment.
We look forward to receiving your application.
GET ON BOARD!

offers.description:
Purpose: 
The Overhead Catenary System (OCS) field engineer/coordinator will join the Edmonton Valley Line West project and report directly to the OCS package manager. 
He will be responsible for the OCS installation on the EVLW project including: 
• Mainline 
• Gerry Wright Operation & Maintenance Facilities (OMF) 
• Lewis Farm OMF 

Key responsibilities: 
• Ensure adherence to Project Safety policies. 
• Review and understand project schedule. 
• Serves as a liaison with project management reporting on inspections, subcontracting (if any), progress, and delays. 
• Participates in project meetings and facilitates regularly scheduled meetings related to execution and deliverables for the project. 
• Proactively identifies and works to resolve any site issues that may impede the project delivery. 
• Responsible for implementing and monitoring all OCS related works on site as per the defined scope of work. 
• Have a strong knowledge of the project agreement (PA), project specifications, approved drawings and control that all work are performed accordingly. 
• Initiate and monitor Field Change Directive in close relation with site team, package manager and the OCS Engineer of Record (EoR). 
• Lookahead planning of material requisitions and other resources as needed. 
• Monitor with the warehouse manager the OCS preparation works or any works related to OCS installation and performed at the Warehouse. 
• Monitor closely the stored material, tools and consumables with the yard manager to avoid any shortage. 
• Prepare schedule for the installation activities. 
• Monitor installation activities with the OCS superintendent / site supervisor 
• Plans and coordinates site activities with Safety and Quality departments to ensure applicable procedure enforcement. 
• Plan and coordinate site activities with other sub-systems construction representatives to avoid/minimize installation conflicts (clashes). 
• Support site team for all design and technical related queries. 
• Initiate Non-Conformity Report through Aconex when required. 
• Monitor Non-Conformity and is responsible for closing it within the allowed timeframe. 
• Perform site quantity take offs. 
• Establish the daily progress report and other related reports, inspect documents which relate to site activities. 
• Participate actively in the monthly cost control for the OCS budget and in the OCS budget reviews under the authority of the package manager. 
• Report any close call, incident or accident to the safety department and the line management. 
• Actively represent the company in a professional manner at all times by providing clear on-site communication / clear understandable work reports / regular communication with the concerned parties responsible for timely escalation of any issues or occurrences. 
• Other duties assigned by Package Manager

Coengi est une société de conseil en ingénierie en pleine expansion, spécialisée dans l’accompagnement de projets techniques ambitieux et innovants. Notre mission ? Des projets à fort impact dans un environnement technique innovant : L’opportunité d’évoluer dans un secteur en pleine transformation digitale.

offers.description:
Présentation de l'entreprise:
Caderac est la filiale ivoirienne du groupe de BTP Hervé, basé dans l'ouest de la France.
Producteur local de granulats (sables, graves, graviers, enrochements), Caderac alimente les chantiers du bâtiment, des routes et des grands projets en Côte d’Ivoire.
Avec trois carrières : Abidjan (PK44), Bouaké (route de Béoumi) et Aboisso (route d’Ayamé) et Laoundi Ba (Bondoukou Nord), nous sécurisons la qualité, la continuité d’approvisionnement et la proximité logistique, pour des coûts livrés maîtrisés et des délais tenus.
Partenaire de confiance des plus grands projets de Côte d’Ivoire, Caderac s’impose comme un fournisseur de granulats de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest.

Contexte
Dans le cadre de notre développement international, nous recherchons un(e) Volontaire International en Entreprise (VIE) pour rejoindre notre équipe en Côte d’Ivoire, spécialisé(e) en mécanique appliquée au secteur minier. Le/la candidat(e) interviendra sur la maintenance, l’optimisation, le montage et le transfert des installations industrielles utilisées dans les opérations minières, en collaboration avec les équipes locales et le siège social.

Missions principales
- Suivi de transfert d’installations industrielles : Coordination des opérations de démontage, transport, remontage et remise en service des installations industrielles.
- Maintenance et optimisation des équipements : Planification, suivi et amélioration des performances des machines et installations industrielles minières.
- Diagnostic technique : Analyse des pannes, proposition de solutions correctives et préventives pour assurer la continuité des opérations.
- Optimisation des processus : Proposition et mise en oeuvre de solutions pour améliorer la fiabilité, la sécurité et l’efficacité des installations industrielles.
- Reporting : Rédaction de rapports techniques, de fiches de maintenance et de tableaux de bord pour le suivi des performances.

Pourquoi postuler?
- Expérience internationale valorisante en Côte d’Ivoire, dans un secteur industriel porteur.
- Immersion dans un environnement technique exigeant et dynamique.
- Opportunité de développer un réseau professionnel à l’international et d’acquérir une expertise reconnue en mécanique industrielle appliquée aux mines.
offers.profile:
Profil recherché
- Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur en mécanique, maintenance industrielle, ou équivalent avec une spécialisation ou expérience en milieu minier.
- Expérience : Une première expérience en maintenance ou gestion d’installations industrielles, idéalement dans le secteur minier (stage, alternance).
- Homme/Femme de terrain : Goût prononcé pour le travail sur le terrain, capacité à évoluer dans des environnements parfois exigeants, résistance physique et psychologique, sens pratique et réactivité face aux imprévus.
- Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic mécanique, connaissance des normes de sécurité et des méthodes de maintenance appliquées

offers.title: Test and Commissioning Engineer (H/F)
offers.description:
Could you be the full-time VIE S&C Test and Commissioning Engineer in Montreal, Canada, we’re looking for?

Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your technical expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative and collaborative teammates.
You'll play a key role in the preparation and execution of on-site testing for S&C (Signalling & Low Voltage) subsystems, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, project strategies, and company policies. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (installation teams, engineering teams, subcontractors), analyze system anomalies, and contribute to the implementation of corrective actions, and much more.
 
You’ll specifically take care of deploying baselines and configuring software, virtual machines, databases, networks, and firewalls, but also performing tests, producing reports, and applying cybersecurity standards.
We’ll look to you for:
• Drafting test procedures based on contractual requirements
• Preparing test books according to approved procedures
• Deploying software configurations and managing virtual environments
• Executing subsystem tests and producing related reports
• Analyzing anomalies using system logs and diagnostic tools
• Implementing corrective actions in collaboration with the engineering team
• Ensuring cybersecurity requirements are met during all activities
• Maintaining site safety conditions during operations
• Updating tracking tools and producing progress KPIs
• Providing regular progress reports to the S&C Test & Commissioning Manager
offers.profile:
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• Degree in computer science, telecommunications, networks, cybersecurity, electronics, automation, or a related field
• Experience or understanding of system testing, troubleshooting, software deployment, or validation of complex IT systems
• Knowledge of Windows and Linux environments
• Familiarity with virtual machines and virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
• Understanding of databases and SQL language
• Knowledge of computer networks, including TCP/IP, IP addressing, VLAN, routing, ports, and protocols
• Ability to configure and troubleshoot firewalls and communication rules
• Understanding of cybersecurity principles such as access control, account management, system hardening, and network segmentation
• Proficiency in tools like Wireshark for network diagnostics
• Experience deploying software baselines and analyzing logs, network traces, and error messages
• Proficiency in Excel for activity tracking and KPI generation
• Fluency in French and English
• Flexibility to work night shifts, weekends, and occasional travel during project phases
 
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

offers.title: Services Quality and Improvement (H/F)
offers.description:
ake on a new challenge and develop your quality management, supplier and project quality, and continuous improvement expertise in a cutting-edge services environment.

As a VIE within the Services Quality team, you will support the deployment and continuous improvement of Quality processes across Services activities. You will work in close collaboration with Project Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering and cross-functional teams to help ensure compliance with internal standards, customer expectations and external quality requirements.

You’ll contribute to improving Quality performance by supporting Quality Management System deployment, supplier performance follow-up, non-conformity management, audit preparation, documentation management and problem-solving activities.

We’ll look to you for:
Deploy transverse improvement missions (within and outside Quality), animate company-wide initiatives and ensure sound performance management in all métiers in compliance with centrally-defined governance and guidelines
Promote Quality culture through communication, training, knowledge sharing and capability-building initiatives.
Develop and deploy digital solutions, including AI agents, Power Apps, dashboards and automation tools, to enhance Quality process efficiency, data-driven decision-making and knowledge sharing across Services.
Support continuous improvement programmes through data analysis, reporting, lessons learned, standardised methodologies and process optimisation.
Contribute to audit preparation and follow-up activities.
Drive problem-solving, root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action initiatives.
Support the management of non-conformities and improvement action plans across Services activities.
Contribute to supplier and subcontractor quality performance improvement.
Assist in the deployment and standardisation of Quality processes, control plans, inspection requirements and best practices with focus on Special Processes.
offers.profile:
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

Preferred qualifications and skills:

Degree or equivalent in Engineering, (Quality Management, Industrial Management, Operations, , Electromechanical, Materials), Physics or a related field.
Understanding of quality tools, problem-solving methods, audits, KPIs and continuous improvement practices would be appreciated.
Interest in the railway, transportation, industrial or automotive environment.
Analytical and data-driven mindset.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Curiosity, autonomy and willingness to learn.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools; experience with data mining tools ERP systems or digital reporting tools would be a plus.
Fluent English.
Things you’ll enjoy
Join us on our transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences. You’ll also:

Develop technical and professional skills in a global environment.
Gain hands-on experience in Quality, Supplier and Project Quality and industrial processes.
Contribute to innovative projects that support greener and smarter mobility.
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

offers.title: Data Analyst (H/F)
offers.description:
At LittleBig Connection, we firmly believe in the transformative power of data analytics and AI to enhance business operations, drive informed decision-making and foster sustainable business growth.
To reinforce our young and ambitious Data and AI team we are seeking a Data Analyst. You will own the semantic layer of our data platform: the models, metrics and definitions that the whole company relies on. Beyond reporting, you will be expected to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next and what should be done about it. You will collaborate closely with key business stakeholders (Financial Partners, Head of Business, Product Managers) to develop impactful analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build and maintain the semantic model of the platform with dbt: staging, marts, metrics, tests and documentation.
• Own the definition of business metrics and make sure they are consistent, documented and unique across all consumption surfaces.
• Contribute to data governance: ownership, naming conventions, data contracts, catalog and quality standards on the analytics layer.
• Run diagnostic analyses: identify root causes behind business variations rather than only reporting them.
• Build predictive analyses (forecasting, scoring, propensity) to anticipate business and product trends.
• Turn those insights into prescriptive recommendations: scenarios, simulations and actionable next steps for stakeholders.
• Deliver reporting and visualizations where they are the right answer, on top of the semantic model rather than beside it.
• Collaborate with the data engineering team on pipelines and modelling, and act as a referent on analytics practices within the team.
offers.profile:
Ideal profile:

• Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, IT, or related field
• At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or related fields
• Advanced SQL, and hands-on production experience with dbt
• Strong background in data modelling: dimensional modelling, semantic layers, metric definitions
• Comfortable with Python for statistical and predictive work
• Experience with data governance practices (documentation, ownership, data quality)
• Working knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, preferably Azure Databricks, and of a visualization tool (e.g. Microsoft Power BI)
• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving aptitude, and a high standard of rigor and precision
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
• Proactive and entrepreneurial, you are embracing challenges with enthusiasm
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

If you are interested in working in a fast growing company, on unique and innovative projects where you can use your creativity, this opportunity is tailored for you!

offers.description:
Who we are looking for 

We are seeking an experienced and proactive HR professional with strong expertise in AI, automation, and 
process improvement to join our HR team in Dublin for 2 years. The position will suit someone who is 
curious and innovative and is passionate about improving the way HR works. 

Why this role is important to us 
This is a great opportunity to join the HR team at an exciting time where the future of how we work will be 
shaped. This role will focus on enhancing and streamlining HR processes, reducing manual and repetitive 
tasks, and improving the efficiency and consistency of how the HR function operates. The successful

offers.description:
Arabelle Solutions offers a broad portfolio of turbine island technologies and services that are used in more than a third of nuclear power plants globally – helping customers across the world deliver reliable power as they transition to a lower-carbon future. The Arabelle steam turbine is the most advanced of its kind and the company provides turbine island lifecycle support solutions for all nuclear reactor types - improving power output, reducing environmental footprint, and lowering operational cost. Arabelle Solutions has around 3,300 employees across 16 countries and is a subsidiary of EDF Group. 
At Arabelle Solutions, we’re proud to design services and solutions that are generating power not just for today and tomorrow but for generations to come. You’ll work alongside passionate bright minds. We offer a broad range of opportunities for those eager to build tomorrow’s world. We believe a supportive culture is key to reach common goals. Diversity and an inclusive mindset makes us and our business stronger. 
www.arabellesolutions.com
We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic VIE to join our team at Hinkley Point C (HPC). As an VIE you will be based at HPC and you will support the Lead site Planner in the preparation of site activity, the coordination on site and interface with both internal and external partners as well as the execution of subcontractors and partners. 
This outstanding opportunity will give you hands-on experience with real-world projects, whilst enabling you to develop professional skills and build your resume all under the Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.

Main Responsibilities:
• Assist the Lead Site Planner to prepare guidelines for site reporting and coordination.
• Coordinate and monitor the Subcontractor schedules, and ensure proper interfacing between the various subcontractors and AS schedules, under guidance of the Lead Site Planner.
• Integrate detailed subcontractor schedule activities into the STS with proper alignment, structure, coding and weighting. under guidance of the Lead Site Planner.
• Assist the Lead Site Planner on data on preparation the quarterly Construction project review …
• Generate schedule analysis identifying subcontractor delays, critical paths, recovery plans and acceleration schedules.
• Support the Site Construction Management team in the preparation of the mitigation plans to minimize impacts: NCR, Punch Items, forensic events
• Assist the NCC Manager and the Site Contract Manager for the preparation of the claims (planning data) when needed.
• Support the CMS Planner in the generation of periodic CMS reports.
• Provide schedule, weighting and progress inputs and updates as required by the CMS Planner
• Involvement in daily and weekly meetings with Site project shareholders.
• Hold weekly meeting with EP function
• Develop KPI's and tracking method where needed
• Maintain a database for all schedule data and periodic updates.
• Communicate directly with engineering to clarify any plannification issues
• Participation in return of experience and process standardisation

offers.title: Solutions Engineer (H/F)
offers.description:
About the Company
If you have ever watched television or enjoyed a movie on your phone or tablet, this experience was likely brought to you through an Ateme solution created by our award-winning engineering teams.
Ateme (PARIS: ATEME) is the global leader in video delivery, partnering with top content and service providers, and streaming platforms like Netflix.
Through our cutting-edge R&D and innovation, we enable clients to deliver high-quality video experiences on any device, boosting engagement and revenue.
Guided by a robust CSR policy, we are committed to making the entertainment and video experience captivating, greener, accessible to everyone, while promoting our employees’ well-being and ethical business practices.
At Ateme, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, empowerment, agility, and diverse contributions.

Join us and help shape the future of video delivery!

Want to work on the technology behind global streaming platforms like Netflix? Join ATEME and help deliver high-quality video experiences at scale.

Mission:
As a Solutions Engineer based in Los Angeles, you will support Ateme’s North American business by contributing to the technical sales process for complex video delivery solutions, with a particular focus on NEA technologies and customer requirements.
Working alongside the Solutions Engineering and Sales teams, you will help design, present, and validate technical solutions while developing a strong understanding of customer environments and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
Technical Discovery & Solution Design:
• Partner with Sales and Marketing to understand customer business and technical requirements and recommend appropriate video delivery solutions.
• Participate in technical discovery sessions and contribute to solution design and architecture, particularly around Ateme's NEA technologies.
• Support the development of technical solutions, implementation approaches, and customer roadmaps alongside the Solutions Engineering team.

Demos, POCs & Proposal Support:
• Prepare and deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (POCs) in customer environments.
• Support the technical aspects of RFI/RFP responses, including scope assessment, solution recommendations, and proposal preparation.
• Contribute to statements of work, bills of materials, and technical documentation.

Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration:
• Develop an understanding of customer environments, technical challenges, and business objectives.
• Explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Delivery teams to support customer engagements and smooth implementation handoffs.
• Participate in customer meetings, technical workshops, and industry events, with occasional business travel in accordance with V.I.E program requirements.
• Provide technical guidance and training to customers and partners.
• Progressively develop customer relationship management and commercial skills while supporting the technical sales cycle.

What We’re Looking For:
• Education: Master's degree or Engineering degree (Bac+5) in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Digital Media/Broadcast Technology, or a related technical field.
• Technical Foundation: Good knowledge of IP networking and Linux, with initial exposure to video streaming, encoding/transcoding, OTT, or broadcast technologies.
• Video Technologies: Interest in video delivery architectures, streaming workflows, and software-based video solutions. Familiarity with Ateme's NEA technologies is a plus.
• Industry Exposure: Initial experience through internships, apprenticeships, academic projects, or a first professional experience in video technology, telecommunications, or technical pre-sales.
• Technical & Commercial Interest: Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into technical solutions. A technical-sales specialization or initial customer-facing experience is a plus.
• Cloud & Software: Familiarity with cloud, hybrid, or software-based video workflows is a plus.
• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills, technical curiosity, and a customer-oriented approach to solving technical challenges.
• Communication & Collaboration: Strong presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and commercial teams in an international environment.

Why Join Ateme?
• Hands-On Experience: Contribute to complex North American customer projects involving advanced video delivery technologies.
• Technical Exposure: Gain experience in solution design, technical discovery, demonstrations, POCs, and customer environments.
• Mentorship: Work alongside experienced Solutions Engineers and collaborate closely with Sales and technical teams.
• International Environment: Join a high-performing international team supporting Ateme's North American business.
• Career Growth: Develop technical, commercial, and customer-facing expertise, with potential longer-term career opportunities in Solutions Engineering or Customer Success Management.

Program Details:
• Program: VIE – Solutions Engineer
• Work Environment: Hybrid.
• Location: Los Angeles, California.

Bonnes connaissances en réseaux IP, Linux et technologies de diffusion vidéo (streaming, encodage, OTT, broadcast). Intérêt pour les solutions NEA, l'avant-vente technique et la relation client. Bonnes capacités de communication, esprit d'analyse et anglais professionnel requis. Une première expérience en environnement technique ou client est un plus.

offers.description:
About the Company

If you have ever watched television or enjoyed a movie on your phone or tablet, this experience was likely brought to you through an Ateme solution created by our award-winning engineering teams.
Ateme (PARIS: ATEME) is the global leader in video delivery, partnering with top content and service providers, and streaming platforms like Netflix.
Through our cutting-edge R&D and innovation, we enable clients to deliver high-quality video experiences on any device, boosting engagement and revenue.
Guided by a robust CSR policy, we are committed to making the entertainment and video experience captivating, greener, accessible to everyone, while promoting our employees’ well-being and ethical business practices.
At Ateme, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, empowerment, agility, and diverse contributions.

Join us and help shape the future of video delivery!

Want to work on the technology behind global streaming platforms like Netflix? Join ATEME and help deliver high-quality video experiences at scale.

Mission:
As a VIE IT & Lab Infrastructure Engineer, you will help operate, maintain, and improve Ateme’s IT and engineering lab environment in Denver.
Working hands-on across systems, networks, servers, virtualization, and video infrastructure, you will troubleshoot technical issues and take ownership of day-to-day IT and lab operations in coordination with Ateme’s IT, Engineering, and Cybersecurity teams.

Key Responsibilities:
IT & Network Infrastructure:
• Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows systems, servers, workstations, and network equipment.
• Administer network infrastructure including switches, WiFi, WAN, VLANs, routing, and connectivity.
• Manage firewall rules, access requirements, and network security in coordination with Ateme’s IT and Cybersecurity teams.
• Monitor infrastructure availability and troubleshoot system and network incidents.
• Maintain infrastructure documentation, configurations, network diagrams, and inventories.
• Participate in hardware lifecycle management, infrastructure upgrades, and capacity planning.

Lab Infrastructure & Operations:
• Operate and maintain the Denver engineering lab, including servers, racks, workstations, storage, and virtualization platforms.
• Maintain video-specific infrastructure including SDI routing, RF/antenna systems, origin servers, fiber switching, and NMOS controllers.
• Install and replace equipment, manage cabling, and coordinate RMA and preventive maintenance activities.
• Maintain containerized and Kubernetes-based lab environments.
• Troubleshoot technical issues across systems, networks, hardware, and lab infrastructure.
• Ensure lab systems remain organized, documented, reliable, and available for engineering testing, validation, and demonstrations.

Automation & Continuous Improvement:
• Develop scripts and tools to automate recurring IT and lab operations using technologies such as Python, Bash, APIs, and YAML.
• Improve infrastructure monitoring, configuration, inventory, and internal tools.
• Identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and standardization.
• Contribute to infrastructure upgrades and modernization projects.
• Develop and maintain technical procedures and operational documentation.

IT Security & Governance:
• Apply Ateme IT and cybersecurity standards within the Denver environment.
• Participate in firewall, access-control, and infrastructure security activities.
• Maintain accurate systems, access, and network documentation.
• Coordinate local infrastructure requirements with Ateme’s IT and Cybersecurity teams.

What We’re Looking For:
• Education: Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Telecommunications, IT Infrastructure, or a related technical field.
• Systems & Networking: Good knowledge of Linux, Windows, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, firewalls, servers, and virtualization.
• Industry Exposure: Previous exposure to video delivery, broadcast, streaming, media technology, or telecommunications is a plus.
• Automation & Containers: Familiarity with Python, Bash, APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies is a plus.
• Mindset: Hands-on, proactive, organized, and able to troubleshoot technical issues and work autonomously in an international environment.
• Physical Requirements: Ability to work hands-on in a lab environment and lift equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.

Why Join Ateme?
• Hands-On Experience: Work directly with professional IT, networking, server, storage, and video lab infrastructure.
• Technical Exposure: Build expertise across systems administration, networking, virtualization, automation, cybersecurity, and video technologies.
• Ownership & Autonomy: Take responsibility for technical topics and contribute directly to the reliability and improvement of the Denver environment.
• International Environment: Work closely with IT, Engineering, and Cybersecurity teams across Ateme’s global organization.
• Career Growth: Develop the technical expertise and ownership required to progressively take greater responsibility for Ateme’s IT and lab infrastructure in North America.

Program Details:
• Program: VIE – IT & Lab Infrastructure Engineer, North America.

offers.description:
Avertim Netherlands is currently looking for Quality Engineers able to assist in the continuous expansion of Avertim’s consulting activities in Life Sciences. Located in Amsterdam-Zuid, Avertim Netherlands is a trusted partner by the largest players in the Life Sciences sector.

As a Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring GMP compliance by managing and resolving Non-Conformities (NCs) and driving continuous improvement in quality processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to investigate deviations, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and uphold regulatory standards.

Key responsibilities:

Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of NCs, ensuring timely and effective CAPA implementation, and manage change controls.
Perform root cause analyses and risk assessments to prevent recurrence of deviations.
Ensure compliance with GMP, FDA, EMA, and other regulatory requirements in all quality-related activities.
Collaborate with production, quality control, and regulatory teams to drive improvements in GMP processes.
Conduct internal audits and support external regulatory inspections.
Maintain and improve SOPs, batch records, and other GMP documentation.
Provide GMP training and guidance to operational teams to enhance compliance awareness.

Your background:

A Master’s Degree in Engineering, Pharmacy, Life Sciences or related field
2 years of experience in Pharmaceuticals, Biotech or Medical Devices.
Hands-on experience with NC management, CAPA implementation, change controls, and deviation investigations.
Experience in cell & gene therapy is a plus.
Planning & organization – Planning & organization plans and organizes own work(load) in an effective way by setting priorities and meeting deadlines;
Communicating & influencing – Communicates with clarity, speaks and writes clearly and to the point; active listener;
Proficiency in Lean and Six Sigma methodologies or Project Management
Fluent in English

As an Avertimer, you will get the opportunity to:

Immerse yourself into a young, vibrant, fast-growing team at our modern office, located in the Amsterdam business district, de Zuidas
Enjoy our events, like team activities and afterworks.
Develop yourself in a place where individuals and ideas matter, in line with our company values:

Be yourself

Trust, ownership and respect

Listen and act

With offices in Brussels, Paris, Frankfurt and Amsterdam you will benefit from our international community. On top of that, we also support the opportunity to perform projects at multiple locations.
Access various learning and development opportunities and an interesting career track.

About Avertim:

Avertim is a uniquely positioned Management Consulting Group that bridges the gap between Strategy and Operations. Our mission is to translate the strategy of our clients into actionable projects and enable the alignment between Business, Technology and Management. Founded in 2007, and headquartered on Brussels’ famous Louise Avenue, Avertim has grown into a European consultancy group with more than 300 consultants and offices in Belgium, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.

Looking for a challenging and exciting new step in your career at a recognised international consultancy firm that works with the top players in the Life Sciences sector?

Apply now!

At Avertim, we value talent and mindset. No difference will be made during the recruitment process and applicants will receive consideration for employment whatever their gender, marital status, religion, age, color, sexual orientation, nationality or disability, …

CS Group Canada, une filiale de CS Group, est un chef de file dans le développement et la certification de systèmes essentiels à la sécurité dans les industries de l'aérospatiale, de l'électricité et de la conduite autonome, et la Cybersécurité pour les entreprises développant des technologies embarquées critiques. Réaliser les différentes étapes du développement formel de logiciels (spécification, conception des composants et modules, codage et vérification) ;

Aider à la rédaction des documents techniques finaux.

Participer à l'amélioration continue de la performance de l'équipe (qualité, efficacité, respect des délais).

Dans le cadre du développement de systèmes embarqués pour véhicules électriques et autonomes, vous contribuerez aux activités de cybersécurité automobile conformément à la norme ISO/SAE 21434, en support des équipes projet et des experts cybersécurité.

offers.title: Ingénieur Validation Silicium – Belgique (H/F)
offers.description:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités en Belgique, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Validation Silicium pour intervenir sur des projets de développement de circuits intégrés complexes dans le domaine des semi-conducteurs.

Vos missions
Silicon Bring-Up
• Participer au premier démarrage et à la mise en fonctionnement des nouveaux prototypes silicium.
• Préparer les cartes et plateformes de validation.
• Vérifier les conditions d'alimentation, d'horloge, de reset et de configuration du composant.
• Mettre en œuvre les premières séquences de bring-up et de communication avec le circuit.
• Vérifier le fonctionnement des interfaces de debug et de programmation.
• Analyser les premiers résultats obtenus sur le silicium.
• Identifier les éventuels écarts entre le comportement attendu et le comportement réel du composant.

Validation fonctionnelle
• Définir et exécuter les plans de validation silicium à partir des spécifications du produit.
• Développer des scénarios permettant de valider les différentes fonctionnalités du circuit.
• Vérifier les différents modes de fonctionnement et cas limites.
• Tester les interfaces et périphériques du SoC / ASIC.
• Vérifier les interactions entre les différents blocs matériels et logiciels.
• Identifier, reproduire et documenter les anomalies observées sur le silicium.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Design et Verification pour effectuer les analyses de root cause.

Caractérisation & Performance
• Caractériser les performances du circuit dans différentes conditions de fonctionnement.
• Étudier l'impact de la tension d'alimentation et de la température sur les performances du composant.
• Mesurer et analyser différents paramètres électriques et fonctionnels : fréquence, consommation, courant de fuite, performances des interfaces, temps de réponse, précision, etc.
• Automatiser les campagnes de mesures lorsque nécessaire.

Hardware & Test
• Développer et mettre au point des plateformes de validation hardware.
• Utiliser des cartes d'évaluation et des prototypes de test.
• Interfacer le composant avec différents équipements de laboratoire.
• Réaliser des mesures à l'aide d'instrumentation électronique : oscilloscope, multimètre, alimentation programmable, générateur de signaux, analyseur logique, analyseur de spectre, etc.
• Développer ou adapter des scripts permettant de piloter les équipements et d'automatiser les mesures.
• Analyser les signaux électriques et les comportements temporels du composant.

Firmware & Software de validation
• Développer ou adapter du firmware de test permettant de piloter le silicium.
• Développer des scripts de validation et d'automatisation en Python, C/C++ ou environnement équivalent.
• Mettre en place des séquences permettant de configurer, stimuler et monitorer le composant.
• Automatiser les campagnes de validation et la collecte des données.
• Développer des outils d'analyse des résultats.
• Participer à la mise en place de tests de non-régression.
• Analyser les logs et résultats issus des campagnes de validation.
offers.profile: De formation Ingénieur(e) ou Bac+5 en électronique, microélectronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaine similaire, vous disposez idéalement de 2 ans ou plus d'expérience en validation hardware, validation silicium ou systèmes embarqués.

offers.title: INGÉNIEUR(E) EN AUTOMATISME (H/F)
offers.description:
Votre environnement technique

Nos ingénieurs en Automatisme pilotent les activités d' « Engineering & Commissioning ». Nous prenons actuellement en main des sujets d’envergure dans de nombreux domaines tels que la défense, le médical, le transport, l’énergie ou encore le nucléaire. Notre expertise s’applique à la production et/ou à la chefferie de projet notamment dans des environnements techniques complexes : le domaine de l’eau, le gaz, le milieu hospitalier, etc.

Nos interventions s’articulent autour de problématiques techniques liées aux dimensions :

- Infrastructure
- Utilities
- Electricite Automatisme
- HVAC / CVC
- Process
- Project management

Vos responsabilités métier 

Pour accompagner l’équipe, vous êtes capable de prendre le lead sur tout ou partie des responsabilités métiers suivantes : 

- Rédaction des cahiers des charges et analyses fonctionnelles 
- Concevoir les programmes sur les automates 
- Développer la supervision 
- Mettre en place les systèmes et vérifier la conformité et le fonctionnement des installations par des tests 
- Réaliser la mise en service des installations chez le client 
- Réaliser les mises au point et assistance aux installations sur site client 
- Assurer l’interface avec les clients 
- Effectuer le reporting (état d’avancement, Non-conformité, etc.) 

Vos atouts pour réussir 

- Vous maîtrisez PC Vue et/ou Wincc 
- Vous avez de bonnes connaissances dans les IHM Vijeo et Proface 
- Vous programmez les automates Schneider et/ou Siemens et/ou Rockwell et/ou Omron et/ou Honeywell et/ou Beckoff.
offers.profile:
Issu(e) d’une formation Bac+5 (Master ou cycle d’Ingénieur) en automatisme. Vous justifiez d’un stage ou d'une alternance sur un poste similaire. Autonome et rigoureux(se), vous disposez de fortes compétences techniques. Vous appréciez travailler en équipe. 

Vous avez une appétence forte pour les projets complexes et la résolution de problématiques. On reconnait votre curiosité et votre culture technique dans le milieu professionnel mais aussi dans le milieu personnel. Vous avez une remise en cause facile et cherchez constamment à vous améliorer. 

Vous entreprenez, portez des projets, des engagements. Vous challenger vos méthodes et vos idées pour vous dépasser et atteindre un haut niveau d’excellence. Dans ce contexte, vos moteurs peuvent être techniques, financiers ou humains, vous serez valorisé sur votre performance et/ou celle de votre équipe.

Nous opérons dans 8 secteurs clés, dont l’aéronautique - spatial, l’automobile, la défense, l’énergie, le BTP – Infrastructure – Ferroviaire, l’IT – Télécommunications, Life Sciences, Banque – Finance – Assurances.
